VirtualDesktop PowerShell module (v1.5.11, 2025-08-25)
Original author: Markus Scholtes
License: MIT (see LICENSE in this folder)
Source: PowerShell Gallery (https://www.powershellgallery.com/packages/VirtualDesktop/1.5.11)
         GitHub: https://github.com/MScholtes/VirtualDesktop

Vendored into NingBingJue to avoid per-machine Install-Module and
admin/elevation scope issues. Runtime imports the module via an absolute
-Path (no PSModulePath dependency, works under the always-elevated exe).
